[http://www.bbc.co.uk/radio/aod/radio4_a ... itchhikers](http://www.bbc.co.uk/radio/aod/radio4_aod.shtml?hitchhikers) )

While I was preparing a master plate, just moments ago, I thought about how one tip that Bernadette Olsen shared with me a year ago has made a real difference in the quality and quantity of the holograms I've been able to make and I wanted to shoot her an email saying so.

That's when I thought that with the snits that have been taking up space here, there hasn't been much thanks given out on the board.

So I'd like to thank the following people in particular:

Colin firstly for setting up the original forum and giving us a place to meet.

Dinesh for sharing his depth and breadth of experience and knowledge.

The PCG'ers who helped make the first gathering a success by participating and/or contributing to the event.

and finally everyone on the forum who participate in the discussions in whatever way they can.

Thanks.

posts.author: Gary Deal
posts.content_md:
I'd like to second that, Thanks to Colin, Dinesh (hope he comes back), Martin, Sergio, the newbies and the old hands, and Michael too! (and the hundred or more I left out - and I still miss Jon) There's plenty here to feed inspiration and we're hardly even tapping the knowledge and expertise that's connected with this place. I know what it's like to try doing this when there's *nobody* to talk to about it, it's like sitting alone on christmas or new year's eve because there's nowhere for you to go.

Thanks!
